titleEn: Extreme weather risk is scaring big corporations away from poorer countries – that hurts the companies, too
titleZh: 极端天气让大企业远离较贫穷国家，这也会伤害企业自身
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: When multinational companies decide where to build a factory, open a mine or establish a regional office, they have to consider whether the investment will still be profitable years into the future.
paragraphs.zh: 当跨国公司决定在哪里建厂、开矿或设立地区办事处时，他们必须考虑投资在未来几年是否仍能盈利。

paragraphs.en: Making that decision increasingly means thinking about risks, like whether surrounding roads will flood, worker safety will be compromised by extreme heat in the summer, and clean water will be available.
paragraphs.zh: 做出这一决定越来越意味着要考虑风险，比如周围的道路是否会被洪水淹没，工人的安全是否会受到夏季极端高温的影响，以及是否有清洁的水可用。

paragraphs.en: As climate change increases the frequency and intensity of extreme weather events around the world, these effects can be especially severe in poorer countries that lack the resources to prepare for disasters or recover quickly after they hit.
paragraphs.zh: 随着气候变化增加了世界各地极端天气事件的频率和强度，这些影响在缺乏资源为灾害做准备或在灾害发生后迅速恢复的较贫穷国家尤为严重。

paragraphs.en: I study how political and environmental risks affect international business. In my new book, “Multinational Corporations and Climate Change: Risks, Responsibilities, and Resilience,” I explore how disaster risk is affecting the ways global companies see these climate-vulnerable markets, and how those views are leading some foreign investors to avoid these developing nations altogether.
paragraphs.zh: 我研究政治和环境风险如何影响国际商业。在我的新书《跨国公司与气候变化：风险、责任和复原力》中，我探讨了灾害风险如何影响全球公司看待这些气候脆弱市场的方式，以及这些观点如何导致一些外国投资者完全避开这些发展中国家。

paragraphs.en: Low- and middle-income countries aren’t the only ones that suffer when multinational corporations pass them by. The companies themselves also stand to lose out on business opportunities in emerging markets if they pull away.
paragraphs.zh: 当跨国公司与低收入和中等收入国家擦肩而过时，它们并不是唯一的受害者。如果跨国公司撤离，它们自己也将失去新兴市场的商业机会。

paragraphs.en: How climate risk affects foreign investment
paragraphs.zh: 气候风险如何影响外国投资

paragraphs.en: Evidence from several studies suggests that multinationals are systematically avoiding investing in the most climate-vulnerable countries. These include my own analysis of 159 countries. Although these studies focus on different samples, they identify the same trend: Countries characterized by greater climate vulnerability received less foreign investment.
paragraphs.zh: 几项研究的证据表明，跨国公司正在系统性地避免在最易受气候影响的国家投资。其中包括我自己对159个国家的分析。尽管这些研究关注的样本不同，但它们发现了同一个趋势：气候脆弱性更大的国家获得的外国投资更少。

paragraphs.en: The results are not trivial. My book identifies a 12% reduction in foreign direct investment for each 1-point rise in climate vulnerability on a 100-point scale, while holding other relevant factors constant. This vulnerability data measures countries’ exposure to climate hazards as well as their capacity to adapt.
paragraphs.zh: 结果并不简单。我在书中指出，在保持其他相关因素不变的情况下，气候脆弱性在100分制上每上升1分，外国直接投资就会减少12%。这种脆弱性数据衡量了各国面临气候灾害的风险以及它们的适应能力。

paragraphs.en: Companies rarely say why they’re avoiding a particular location, but their climate-related concerns occasionally become visible.
paragraphs.zh: 公司很少说他们为什么要避开某个特定的地点，但他们对气候的担忧偶尔会变得明显。

paragraphs.en: For example, Google halted plans to build a US$200 million data center in Chile after an environmental court revoked its construction permit over the likely effects on water supplies and the environment. Similarly, a $1 billion data center proposed in Kenya by Microsoft and the Abu Dhabi-based artificial intelligence company G42 was delayed and ultimately suspended amid concerns about water stress in the area.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，谷歌（Google）停止了在智利建造一个价值2亿美元的数据中心的计划，此前一家环境法院因该项目可能对供水和环境造成影响而撤销了该项目的施工许可。同样，微软（Microsoft）和总部位于阿布扎比的人工智能公司G42在肯尼亚提议的一个价值10亿美元的数据中心也被推迟，最终因担心该地区的水资源紧张而暂停。

paragraphs.en: Companies have reason to be cautious about climate risks.
paragraphs.zh: 企业有理由对气候风险保持谨慎。

paragraphs.en: One analysis of 71 large publicly traded companies found that firms reporting major flood losses experienced a 5% average decline in shareholder value over the following year, after accounting for broader market movements.
paragraphs.zh: 一项对71家大型上市公司的分析发现，在考虑到更广泛的市场波动后，报告重大洪水损失的公司在第二年的股东价值平均下降了5%。

paragraphs.en: In Vietnam, typhoons and floods caused an estimated $475 million in damage to energy and transportation infrastructure in 2022. Unreliable infrastructure cost companies there about $280 million.
paragraphs.zh: 在越南，2022年台风和洪水对能源和交通基础设施造成的损失估计为4.75亿美元。不可靠的基础设施使当地企业损失约2.8亿美元。

paragraphs.en: Severe flooding in Thailand in 2011 forced several companies, including Toyota, Nissan and Honda, to temporarily suspend production as factories flooded, shutting down production of parts or vehicles made there.
paragraphs.zh: 2011年泰国发生的严重洪灾迫使包括丰田、日产和本田在内的几家公司因工厂被洪水淹没而暂时停产，关闭了在那里生产的零部件或车辆的生产。

paragraphs.en: Costs like those shape where companies choose to invest next.
paragraphs.zh: 这样的成本决定了公司下一步的投资方向。

paragraphs.en: While climate risk does not stop all investment in climate-vulnerable markets, it does make projects in these nations relatively more expensive, less attractive and more difficult to finance than less risky locations.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然气候风险不会阻止对气候脆弱市场的所有投资，但它确实使这些国家的项目相对于风险较低的地区而言成本更高，吸引力更低，融资难度更大。

paragraphs.en: Who loses from investor avoidance?
paragraphs.zh: 谁会因投资者回避而受损？

paragraphs.en: For developing countries, less foreign investment means fewer jobs are created. These countries also have fewer opportunities to benefit from exposure to the new technologies that multinationals bring when they invest abroad.
paragraphs.zh: 对发展中国家来说，外国投资减少意味着创造的就业机会减少，这些国家也没有多少机会从跨国公司在国外投资时带来的新技术中受益。

paragraphs.en: Those results highlight another way climate change is deepening global inequality. It reduces the economic activity that could support future development, while simultaneously damaging physical infrastructure and threatening human health and well-being.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果突出表明，气候变化正在以另一种方式加深全球不平等：它减少了可支持未来发展的经济活动，同时破坏了有形基础设施，威胁到人类健康和福祉。

paragraphs.en: Developing countries are especially vulnerable to the effects of rising global temperatures, whether for their dependence on agricultural markets, geography or relatively fragile infrastructure. A report from the Climate Impact Lab at the University of Chicago projects that 90% of heat-related deaths in the coming decades will take place in low- and middle-income countries. Similarly, a 2022 study found that around 90% of people exposed to flooding live in developing nations.
paragraphs.zh: 发展中国家尤其容易受到全球气温上升的影响，无论是因为它们对农产品市场的依赖、地理位置还是相对脆弱的基础设施。芝加哥大学气候影响实验室（Climate Impact Lab）的一份报告预测，未来几十年，90%与高温有关的死亡将发生在中低收入国家。同样，2022年的一项研究发现，大约90%遭受洪水的人生活在发展中国家。

paragraphs.en: Yet poor countries have contributed only a tiny fraction of the emissions that are causing climate change, even as they face the brunt of the damage. For example, African countries are responsible for less than 4% of greenhouse gas emissions globally. But they stand to experience the greatest negative effects of climate change.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，贫穷国家在造成气候变化的排放量中只占很小一部分，尽管它们面临着最大的损害。例如，非洲国家的温室气体排放量不到全球的4%。但它们将承受气候变化的最大负面影响。

paragraphs.en: Lost opportunities for multinational companies
paragraphs.zh: 跨国公司失去的机会

paragraphs.en: When a company avoids investing in climate-vulnerable countries, that may reduce its exposure to floods, droughts or extreme heat, but the decision also carries potential costs for the company.
paragraphs.zh: 当一家公司避免在气候脆弱的国家投资时，这可能会减少其遭受洪水、干旱或极端高温的风险，但这一决定也会给公司带来潜在的成本。

paragraphs.en: Many of these countries have growing consumer markets, energy resources or critical minerals that multinationals need. Companies that dismiss them as too risky may lose out on promising opportunities.
paragraphs.zh: 这些国家中有许多都拥有跨国公司所需要的不断增长的消费市场、能源资源或关键矿产。那些认为这些国家风险太大而不予考虑的公司可能会失去有希望的机会。

paragraphs.en: For example, the Democratic Republic of Congo supplies most of the world’s cobalt, while Indonesia has become the dominant producer of nickel. These countries are highly vulnerable to climate change, which is likely scaring some companies away.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，刚果民主共和国供应世界上大部分的钴，而印度尼西亚已成为镍的主要生产国。这些国家极易受到气候变化的影响，这可能会吓跑一些公司。

paragraphs.en: Yet companies with a greater tolerance for risk have established strong positions in those countries’ mineral industries. Thus, more cautious firms may reduce their risk exposure, but they are also surrendering access to important resources and growing markets.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，对风险承受能力较强的公司在这些国家的矿业中占据了有利地位，因此，较谨慎的公司可能会减少风险，但它们也放弃了获得重要资源和不断增长的市场的机会。

paragraphs.en: Reducing investor avoidance
paragraphs.zh: 减少投资者回避

paragraphs.en: There are ways to help companies overcome their climate-risk avoidance so more investment can pour into these countries:
paragraphs.zh: 有一些方法可以帮助企业克服气候风险规避，以便更多的投资可以涌入这些国家：

paragraphs.en: Foreign aid from wealthy countries can help developing countries shore up their roads, ports, electrical grids and water systems before extreme storms or droughts occur. My 2025 study found that climate-vulnerable countries that received more aid for climate adaptation also received more foreign direct investment than those receiving less aid. The result suggests the funding may reassure companies that climate risks are being addressed.
paragraphs.zh: 来自富裕国家的外国援助可以帮助发展中国家在极端风暴或干旱发生之前，对道路、港口、电网和供水系统进行海岸。我在2025年的研究发现，在气候适应方面获得更多援助的气候脆弱国家，也比那些获得较少援助的国家获得了更多的外国直接投资。这一结果表明，这些资金可能会让企业放心，气候风险正在得到解决。

paragraphs.en: International development banks can share some of the risks by providing climate risk insurance to multinationals. This would offer a safety net to absorb some of the losses if a covered disruption prevents a project from operating as intended. The World Bank already offers similar coverage against political risk incidents, which has given companies confidence to invest in countries such as Kenya, Mozambique and Nigeria.
paragraphs.zh: 国际开发银行可以通过向跨国公司提供气候风险保险来分担部分风险。如果承保的中断导致项目无法按预期运行，这将提供一个安全网，以吸收部分损失。世界银行（World Bank）已经针对政治风险事件提供了类似的保险，这让企业有信心在肯尼亚、莫桑比克和尼日利亚等国投资。

paragraphs.en: Better data can give companies more precise information about climate risks. Many risk scores label entire nations as vulnerable or not, even though exposure varies from one city or project site to another. More detailed information about local flood exposure, water availability, heat, infrastructure and adaptation capabilities would allow companies to limit their avoidance to the riskiest areas, instead of bypassing those countries altogether.
paragraphs.zh: 更好的数据可以让企业获得关于气候风险的更准确信息。许多风险评分将整个国家都标记为脆弱或不脆弱，尽管每个城市或项目所在地的风险敞口不同。有关当地洪水风险、水资源可用性、热量、基础设施和适应能力的更详细信息将使企业能够将规避风险的范围限制在最危险的地区，而不是完全绕过这些国家。

paragraphs.en: Understanding the local risk, insuring companies against risk and helping countries make their infrastructure more resilient to storms, droughts and heat can help boost investment in ways that benefit the companies and spur economic growth and development in climate-vulnerable countries at the same time.
paragraphs.zh: 了解当地风险，为企业提供风险保险，帮助各国提高基础设施对风暴、干旱和高温的抵御能力，有助于促进投资，使企业受益，同时刺激气候脆弱国家的经济增长和发展。
